decisions.evidence: Daily 1264/1267: 35/54, 125/138, 39/32 on Aug 5-7 vs usual 2-10; on Aug 6, 01:00-02:00 alone had 51 N and 67 S (typical night hour ~0); the week of Aug 3 is 215/249 vs 40-90 in the weeks around it; weekday daytime counts those days were normal.

decisions.evidence: 1246/1250 nights 13-16 and 6-15 vs usual 0-2; daily 15-16 vs usual 1-4.

decisions.evidence: 1374 night totals 7, 13, 27 on Aug 5-7 (daily 10-28 vs usual ~4); 1335 is roughly normal by day.

summary: Group G0456 is a single VivaCity camera (counter 317) covering eight zones at Castle Hill Rd and New Line Rd, West Pennant Hills. It counts few bikes (about 1-15 per zone per day) and no automatic fixes were applied. Since June 2025 the feed leaves out whole days with zero bikes for the quiet zones, where it used to publish them as warning zeros; those days are real zeros, but their weeks now show as incomplete. The main fault is a run of weeknight bursts on the New Line Rd road zone (462) on 5-7 Aug 2026, which I set to missing. Smaller bursts of the same kind (Jul 9-10, Sep 1, and the other zones on Aug 5-7) are left in and marked uncertain.
